_comment: Identity of the product that issues the report. Everything here is NON-translatable: a name and a colour do not change between fr and en. Translatable prose lives in CONFIG/lang/*.json and refers to the name as {product}, which is substituted at render time. Change these four values and the report carries a different identity, with no edit to the template, the renderer or the bundles. No version number belongs here -- CONFIG/version.json is the single source for that.
